summary_en: BHB810 is being tested in adults with advanced gastric or gastroesophageal junction (GEJ) adenocarcinoma. This is a Phase 1/2 study. BHB810 is given as an IV infusion every 2 weeks while participants are on study treatment. The study mainly looks at how safe BHB810 is, and it also looks at how well it works, how it moves through the body, and how the body reacts to it.
summary_es: BHB810 se está probando en adultos con adenocarcinoma avanzado de estómago o de la unión gastroesofágica (GEJ). Es un estudio de Fase 1/2. BHB810 se administra por infusión intravenosa cada 2 semanas mientras los participantes reciben el tratamiento del estudio. El estudio se enfoca principalmente en qué tan seguro es BHB810, y también observa qué tan bien funciona, cómo se mueve por el cuerpo y cómo reacciona el organismo ante él.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older, or the legal age of consent where the study takes place.
Advanced gastric or GEJ adenocarcinoma that progressed, did not respond to treatment, or has no standard curative therapy.
At least one measurable target lesion at baseline per RECIST 1.1.
Tumor tissue available; fresh biopsies needed for backfill cohorts and Phase 2.
CDH17-positive by central testing for Phase 1 backfill cohorts and Phase 2 participants.
not_for: Prior CDH17-directed therapy or an antibody drug conjugate with an auristatin (MMAE or MMAF).
Recent chemotherapy, targeted therapy, monoclonal antibody, or immune checkpoint inhibitor within the stated time windows.
Known allergy to BHB810 or its excipients, or left ventricular ejection fraction below 50%.
QTc above 470 msec, or a medication known to prolong QT/QTc.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, planning pregnancy, or known or suspected untreated brain metastases, leptomeningeal disease, or spinal cord compression.
